entry.title: Architectural Preservation District Commission: the meeting of 6 October 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Commission voted unanimously to support the food pantry's variance for modular units, and to seek a joint meeting on the Brooks House. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E2OZuLqP4zE), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: Architectural Preservation District Commission: agenda posted for the meeting of 6 October 2026
entry.summary: The town posted the agenda for the Architectural Preservation District Commission meeting of 6 October 2026. The agenda itself: https://www.lunenburgma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_10062026-8049

entry.title: Architectural Preservation District Commission: the meeting of 16 January 2027 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: APDC sent legal questions on its demolition bylaw to executive session amid a push to merge with the Historical Commission. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bpDu97Bl-go), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
